name: merge-8
branch: exp/merge-8 (deliverable branch moe-ffn-opt-11x8 at the same HEAD)
grid: Both ops on 11x8 (88 cores, logical y 0-7). UNIFIED_ROUTED_EXPERT_CORE_GRID logged as 11-8 in every run log; kCoreGridX/Y = 11/8, adaptive_chunk::kGridY = 8; swiglu all_cores = CoreRange((0,0),(grid_x-1,grid_y-1)) with core_grid (11,8). Every CoreRange, multicast rectangle and worker_core_from_logical_core call in both factories stays inside (0..10, 0..7); the new counts broadcasts reuse the full-grid 11x8 rectangle. r-10rows commits not taken.
base: main build host + untouched git archive of 768453d91be (.base_root, pytest CWD there)
new: worktree build (ttnn/ttnn/_ttnn.so, build_Release) + worktree kernels (pytest CWD = worktree)
step_ab_method: Same worktree build for both sides, kernels from git-archive snapshots: m7 = merge (steps 1-4), m8 = + step 5, new = + step 6. Host changes of steps 5/6 are backward compatible with older kernels (appended RT arg, extra semaphore, shared start CB). ab1 order m7,m8,new; ab2 order new,m8,m7; value = median of the two runs (each a median of 3).
method: RT device time, median of 3 per run; 2 alternating runs per side (fb1, ff1, fb2, ff2); delta = median(new) - median(base), us
control: Step-5 A/B doubles as a control for swiglu (identical swiglu kernels m7 vs m8): swiglu deltas there are noise, |d| <= 3.1 us at ISL 256-320 and <= 0.9 us at ISL <= 128. Step-6 A/B likewise for routed (identical routed kernels m8 vs new): |d| <= 0.5 us everywhere.

Owner rule x_owner_eligible = (gx % kGridY) != gy with kGridY = 8, as built and measured on 11x8.

commits.what: step 5: routed start page folded into the counts broadcast
commits.resolution: Only the routed reader/writer start-in-broadcast part taken (no swiglu edits, no zone renames, no zi_exp.h include). BUG in the patch as written: reader and writer use DIFFERENT start CBs (reader c_15, writer c_14), so skipping the writer's read left c_14 stale -> routed PCC 0.934 at ISL 512 (zero-isl only ever checked ISL 0). Fixed on the host: the writer's cb_start_scratch CT arg (#15) now names the reader's c_15 and c_14 is no longer allocated. So step 5 is no longer kernel-only (one host line + CB removal).

commits.what: step 6: swiglu counts/idx(/start) read once by core (0,0) and multicast to the grid
commits.resolution: new. Broadcast hoisted out of the per-expert loop; linked data multicasts then the counts-valid semaphore (non-linked, ends the chain); receivers wait and reset. Uses the common full-grid h-mcast rectangle. Host: SEM_COUNTS_VALID = 15 (moe_fused_swiglu only; SEM_COUNT unchanged so the hybrid op's pass-barrier id stays < 16), one per-core RT arg appended after the group rect, counts scratch 2 pages only with NEED_START. A first version with an always-2-page scratch measured +2.2/+3.7 us on kimi_k2_7 ndshard ISL 256/320 (step6_first_try in notes); the NEED_START-only sizing is neutral there. The hybrid op has its own forked kernels and is unaffected.

noc1_rule: No NoC1 read overlaps a linked multicast chain: both new chains (routed start, swiglu counts) run on NoC0 at kernel start, and each core's writer (NoC1) first waits on its reader's counts push / mailbox, which follows the chain-terminating semaphore.

threshold_recommendation.semantics: TtRoutedExpert: swiglu takes counts <= threshold (max_active_tokens), routed takes > threshold.
threshold_recommendation.reason: Merged 11x8 build, ndshard, 2 runs each. swiglu wins 256-288 by 0.7-9 us (both models; glm by 8.5-9 at 272/288). At 320 (counts 289-320 share the 10-tile M) glm ties (swiglu -0.8 us) while kimi_k2_7 routed wins by 4.0 us; from 352 routed wins by 11-18 us. Below 256 it is model-dependent within ~3 us (glm routed -2.0 at 192, kimi swiglu -1.9 to -3.0). Crossover: between 288 and 320 for kimi_k2_7, at ~320 for glm_53. Threshold 288 gains ~4 us for kimi at 289-320 and costs ~0.8 us for glm. Config not changed.

additivity: Routed merged delta ~= r-silu + r-tilize-e2e (winners measured separately on 768453d91be): within ~1 us at ISL 384/512/544/1024 (e.g. glm nd 512 -16.6 vs sum -15.7; kimi nd 1024 -29.4 vs -29.0; glm int 544 -25.1 vs -24.1). Step 5 adds -1.2 us at ISL 0 only. Swiglu merged delta ~= s-combo within ~2 us except kimi nd 256 (-2.2 vs -7.9) and ISL 288 glm nd (-16.5 vs -10.8); step 6 adds -1.1 us at ISL 0 and -4 to -7 us at interleaved ISL 256.
